description: This bar chart illustrates the classification accuracy of various models on novel real-world classification tasks, comparing their performance in terms of accuracy percentage. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, labeled with different model names, including RoBERTa w/o Exp., ExEnt, LaSQuE (mean), LaSQuE, LaSQuE (syn2real), and LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum, in a specific order. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, with a linear scale ranging from 40% to 65%, and tick labels at every 5% interval. Each bar corresponds to a model, with distinct colors: RoBERTa w/o Exp. is gray, ExEnt is light blue, LaSQuE (mean) is orange, LaSQuE is green, LaSQuE (syn2real) is purple, and LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum is dark gray. The approximate accuracy values are: RoBERTa w/o Exp. at 46%, ExEnt at 55%, LaSQuE (mean) and LaSQuE both around 47%, LaSQuE (syn2real) at 59%, and LaSQuE (syn2real) + curriculum at 62%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, but rather follow the order of the categories on the horizontal axis, with no bars being visually emphasized.
